# CodeSesh

> CodeSesh is a local developer tool that turns session history from nine AI coding agents into project-aware, structurally searchable, replayable engineering memory.

## Canonical Links

- [English landing page](https://codesesh.xingkaixin.me/)
- [Chinese landing page](https://codesesh.xingkaixin.me/zh/)
- [Markdown landing page](https://codesesh.xingkaixin.me/index.md)
- [Full product knowledge](https://codesesh.xingkaixin.me/llms-full.txt)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/xingkaixin/codesesh)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/codesesh)

## What CodeSesh Does

CodeSesh scans supported local AI coding session stores and presents them through one localhost Web UI. It organizes sessions by project, indexes conversation and file activity, supports structured global search, replays complete task histories, and shows token and cost data when available.

## Supported Agents

- Claude Code
- Cursor
- Kimi
- Kimi-Code
- Codex
- Grok
- Pi
- OpenCode
- ZCode

## Core Capabilities

- Discover: zero-configuration scanning, a unified timeline, and live refresh.
- Organize: project identity, nested session trees, smart tags, aliases, and bookmarks.
- Recover: structured search, file activity lookup, and keyboard navigation.
- Replay: ordered messages and tool calls, token and cost visibility, and a local SQLite index.

## Install

```bash
npx codesesh
```

CodeSesh opens a local Web UI at `http://localhost:4521`. The published CLI requires Node.js 22 or later.

## Data Boundary

CodeSesh does not upload AI coding session data. Session content and the SQLite index remain on the user's computer. No account, cloud sync, or session telemetry is required. CodeSesh may fetch public model pricing metadata for cost estimation; that request does not contain session content.

## Key Questions

### What is CodeSesh?

A local developer tool for discovering, organizing, searching, and replaying AI coding session history.

### Does CodeSesh upload local AI session data?

No. Session content, file paths, token statistics, recorded costs, and the local index remain on the user's computer.

### How do I start CodeSesh?

Run `npx codesesh` in a terminal.

### How does it handle large histories?

It persists scan progress, restores from a SQLite cache, incrementally watches changed files, and virtualizes long conversation timelines.

## Chinese Summary

CodeSesh 将九种 AI 编码 Agent 的本地会话按项目组织到同一个 SQLite 索引中，提供结构化搜索、文件活动索引和完整会话回放。会话数据不上传，无需账号、云同步或会话遥测。
